name: sgs/form-field-date
title: SGS Date Field
description: A date picker input field with min/max date constraints.

label.label: Field label
label._note: Renders as <label class="sgs-form-field__label"> — no per-instance colour/font-size/weight attribute exists on this block; the label is styled entirely by shared framework CSS across the form-field siblings. clusters: [] is a genuine gap, not hidden.

input.label: Date input
input._note: Renders as <input type="date" class="sgs-form-field__input"> — border/background/typography come entirely from shared framework CSS; minDate/maxDate are HTML min/max constraints, not style attributes. No per-instance style attribute exists. clusters: [] is a genuine gap.

help.label: Help text
help._note:
helpText itself is field-behaviour content, not a style property (Bean's non-cluster rule) — the rendered

also carries no per-instance style attribute of its own. clusters: []. The conformance checker's orphan scanner reports helpText as an ORPHAN here (element-key-as-fallback-prefix convention coincidentally matches help+Text); this is a known false-positive of the checker, not evidence of an unaccounted style control.

error.label: Error message
error._note: Populated by client-side validation JS, not a block attribute; the <span class="sgs-form-field__error"> has no per-instance style attribute. clusters: [].
